repository_evidence: The encounter only starts for players standing on the elevator transport (spell_nefarians_end_onyxia_start_fight_2_effect filters on GetTransGUID).
Onyxia cannot die before Nefarian has landed; Nefarian cannot die before phase 3.
Electrocute is scheduled 5 s after each 10% of Nefarian's health and adds 17 Onyxia charge.
Onyxia Electrical Charge ticks every 3 s (SpellMgr correction; client 1 s); Nefarian's copy adds 1 per 2 s while he is aggressive; overload at 100 stacks.
Shadowflame Breath deals one 1.5 s tick (SpellMgr correction; client 3 ticks at 0.5 s) in a 90-degree default cone.
Hail of Bones summons one bone warrior per tick: 4 in 10N, 10 in 25N, 5 in 10H, 12 in 25H (client periods 6/2.4/4.8/2 s over 24 s).
Animate Bones costs 3 energy per 1 s tick with no regeneration: a warrior collapses about 33 s after (re)animation; Breath and Shadowblaze refill it.
Empower (every 4 s): +100% damage and +10% speed per stack in normal, +200%/+15% heroic; a stunned warrior cannot gain a stack.
Bone warriors (38.7M health, mechanic_immune_mask 8462871) are not immune to stun, root, snare or Shackle Undead.
Brushfire Start (Shadowblaze Spark) targets one Animated Bone Warrior (conditions); Shadowblaze 81007 reanimates warriors within 4 yd.
Three prototypes (1.63M health in 10N) cast Blast Nova (4 s cast, 30 s room-wide aura); normal phase 3 needs all three dead, heroic only one.
Phase 2 falls back to phase 3 after 150 s (DBM Shadowflame Barrage active window 150 s agrees).
The Shadowblaze Spark interval floor was 10 s in every mode; repaired this round to 15 s normal / 10 s heroic (BigWigs and DBM).
Wipe: FAIL despawns spawn group 402 and resummons Nefarian after 30 s; the intro flag is not written to the instance save.

strategy.duty_plan: BotNefarianDutyPlan.h: Nefarian tank = best living tank by capability (Blood DK, Protection Paladin, Protection Warrior, Feral); Onyxia tank = next tank; pillar teams = one healer each, then a <=13 s interrupter where the healer has none, then balanced head count and damage dealers; primary interrupter = shortest cooldown non-healer, backup = next; shackler = first living priest; controllers = other living non-tanks with a stun, snare or root.
strategy.phase_1_damage: Onyxia until 12%, then Nefarian down to 73% while Onyxia's charge is below 60 (two Electrocutes, +34 charge natively), then finish Onyxia.
strategy.movement_interface: SurfaceGoal (BotNefarianMovement.h) reached in legs of at most 9.5 yd (BotNefarianPath.h: centre floor r <= 27 straight, radial rise crossing r 26.5 <-> 33.5 with 0.9 yd floor tolerance, ring straight or along lanes r 33.5 / r 50 that clear the pillars), each submitted as BotNativeAction::TransportSurfaceMove Walk with EndOnTransport (BotNefarianSurfaceIntent.h); never an ordinary Move on the platform. Typed holds: nefarian_elevator_unobserved, nefarian_not_on_platform, nefarian_movement_stunned, nefarian_no_surface_path, nefarian_leg_in_flight.
strategy.phase_2_without_ascent: Typed capability blocker pillar_ascent_unsupported on every plan, in the decision trace and in the nefarian_duty_plan status; teams hold the pillar feet (local r 26). Patch W1 ends the diagnostic run at the first heartbeat with the blocker (encounter_capability_blocker_watchdog), keeping phase 1 evidence.
strategy.phase_1_tanking: Pull: the tank stands on the ring at r 52 on a radially clear heading at the dragon's end; the chasing dragon stops at its reach, about r 29-31. Hold: once the dragon is at r >= 27.5 within 15 degrees of its end, the tank stands 7 yd from it, tangential and 25 degrees outward, so it only turns. Opposite ends are then >= 53 yd apart; the chase-model test settles them 62 yd apart.
strategy.bone_warrior_control: One controller acts per warrior per decision: the first in rotation that is in range and whose control spell is ready (SpellHistory via BotNefarianNativeObserver.h), ordered stuns, roots, cooldown-free snares, then snares with a cooldown; the shackler holds one warrior.

acceptance_observations: Every bot is a passenger of GO 207834 before Onyxia's start-fight pulse (no bot pulls from the ledge).
Dragon separation stays above 50 yd after Nefarian lands (no Children of Deathwing 78619/78620 uptime on either dragon beyond the lead-out).
No non-tank is hit by Shadowflame Breath; Lightning Discharge 77943 lands only during the tank's discharge turn window, if at all.
Two Electrocutes in phase 1 and Onyxia's charge below 100 at her death.
Every bot reaches its pillar top before the floor submerges; no Magma 81114/81118 damage beyond the ascent.
Every Blast Nova 80734 cast is interrupted (SPELL_INTERRUPT events; no 80735 ticks).
No bot damages Nefarian during phase 2 (no Electrocute during phase 2).
Every bot leaves its pillar before Nefarian lands (no Shadow of Cowardice 79353).
Bone warriors spend their active time controlled (Shackle/stun/root/snare auras) and no bone warrior is hit by Breath while active.
No bot takes Shadowblaze 81007 damage for more than one tick.
Native clear: boss state done, encounter credit, 0 boss-window deaths.
